## Problem

What user problem would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior and the expected Telegram-first user experience.

## Health safety/privacy impact

- What health data would be stored or sent to a provider?
- Does this affect BYOK/self-hosting expectations?
- How should PulseKeeper avoid diagnosis, prescription, or fake precision?

## Alternatives considered

What simpler or more local approach might work?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Works without live network calls in unit tests
- [ ] Keeps secrets and private health data out of logs
- [ ] Has a strict TDD test plan
